summary: CostCentre is a system feature for retrieving cost centre records related to placements, aggregating placement data by parameters such as date range, agencies, discipline, site, service, destination, and placement request status. It organizes and exposes structured information for financial and reporting operations.
purpose: To provide detailed cost centre reporting and data for placements, supporting financial tracking, reporting, and accounting tasks within the system. Enables querying of placement cost centre records by multiple filters for analysis and downstream integration.

workflows.name: GetCostCentre
steps: User or system calls GetCostCentre with filtering parameters (sessionID, date range, agencies, discipline, etc.)
Database procedure PlacementCostCentre is executed with provided parameters
Records are retrieved and mapped into CostCentreRecord objects
Results are returned as a list for further processing, display, or reporting

business_rules: All filtering parameters are optional and can be combined as needed.
PlacementCostCentre procedure aggregates placement data by defined fields.
Returned records include assignment details, program year, hours, and financial fields needed for cost centre reporting.
validations: Date range must be valid (StartDate <= EndDate)
UUIDs and IDs must be safely cast for database compatibility
calculations: PRCount: Number of placement requests in scope
StudentCount: Number of students in scope
StudentHours: Total student hours from placements
conditions: Filtering by any field (agencies, discipline, site, service, destination, PRStatus) is possible
Records only returned when matching criteria
system_behavior: Aggregation of placement data over selected filters
Return of detailed structured record per placement
Support for downstream use in reporting or accounting interfaces
exceptions: Invalid filtering parameters cause empty result
Database errors or unsafe casts prevent retrieval
